interface Comparable<T> {
  compareTo(other: T): number;
}
class Version implements Comparable<Version> {
  compareTo(other: number): number {
    return other;
  }
}
abstract class Account {
  protected balance = 0;
  abstract fee(): number;
}
class Savings extends Account {}
const s = new Savings();
console.log(s.balance);
function maxOf<T extends Comparable<T>>(items: T[]): T {
  return items[0];
}
maxOf([1, 2]);
type Tree<T> = { value: T; children: Tree<T>[] };
const t: Tree<number> = { value: "1", children: [] };
const m = new Map([["a", 1]]);
m.set("b", "2");
let x: number = m.get("a");
class P {
  private constructor() {}
}
const p = new P();
function f(this: { n: number }) {
  return this.n;
}
f();
